verdict.rationale: LocalAI documents an OpenAI-compatible API, plus Anthropic Messages and Open Responses support. None of the evidence shows LocalAI publishing its own downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. Probes of the standard OpenAPI and Swagger paths on localai.io all returned 404. Compatibility with OpenAI's API is adjacent at best and does not count as a LocalAI-provided machine-readable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
